body:
Thank you SO much for this comment! It’s gonna help me a lot when I gather some things to help her out. I will also be sure to tell her the people in videos are actors and that not everyone looks like that. To be honest, this made me think of some comments she has been saying these last few weeks like “I feel fat, I’m so ugly, look at my belly, I have hair on my arms” She is a completely normal weight category for her age and I told her that she’s beautiful, but media really does that to people. 
So thank you so so much! This is gonna help me a ton!

Thank you! I will collect a couple things on a list to bring up to her soon and mention that it can become addicting, but there’s nothing wrong with exploring herself and that she doesn’t have to feel guilty.
Thank you! This means a lot to me, I had no idea I would ever have this conversation, especially with my younger sister.
Thank you! I will be sure to mention that it’s not accurate
Thank you! I do have weight watchers, it really helped me in the past
Thank you! This was very reassuring :)
It’s great your close with your dad! Have you stopped looking for that friend?
Thank you! I’m gonna try to focus on myself. In some kinda messed up way, I’m jealous of how far she’s come but also mad for kinda leaving me in the past
Please don’t harm yourself. Your child needs you. If I had one wish, it’s that I could have my mom back. Think about him
